cl.p1: three years at home with two small children are coming to an end, as both start nursery in August. I would like to return to purchasing on 25 hours a week, mornings only.
cl.p2: Before my break I spent six years as a buyer for a furniture supplier: selecting suppliers, negotiating prices and chasing delivery dates. This spring I finished an online course on sustainable sourcing, which has become a much bigger topic while I was away.
cl.p3: Childcare is arranged, including a plan for sick days.

letters.label: Purchasing specialist after three years at home

cl.p1: while my wife finished her specialist medical training, I spent a year at home with our daughter. She has now started nursery, and I am ready to return.
cl.p2: I have ten years’ experience producing construction and detail drawings for residential and commercial buildings. During my leave I learned the latest version of our design software, which your advert says you are moving to.
cl.p3: Full time works for me if I can leave at three twice a week and make up the hours on other days.

letters.label: Father returning after a year at home

name: Returning to work after parental leave
